about.title: Rancho Palos Verdes Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Rancho Palos Verdes sees its share of injury collisions on corridors like Palos Verdes Drive S, Hawthorne Boulevard, and Western Avenue, with recent public records showing 33 injury collisions and 43 people hurt in a single year. Monday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m. tend to see more reported crashes, likely tied to school pickup traffic and commuters navigating the peninsula's curving roads. If you were hurt in one of these crashes, the choices you make in the first days matter: photos of the scene, witness contact information, and a medical evaluation all help preserve evidence before it disappears. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves — we connect injured Rancho Palos Verdes residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the details, deal with the insurance company on your behalf, and explain your options under California law. There's no cost to get connected, and the attorneys in our network only get paid if you recover compensation.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls

items.title: California's Statute of Limitations Runs Fast
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim, but claims against a government entity (like a road defect on a city-maintained street) may require notice in as little as six months. Waiting too long can close the door on your case entirely.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Reduce, Not Erase, Your Recovery
items.desc: California is a pure comparative fault state, meaning you can still recover damages even if you're partly at fault for the collision, though your award is reduced by your share of fault. An attorney can help make sure fault isn't unfairly pinned on you before you've had a chance to tell your side.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: California places no cap on compensation for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses in a standard car accident case. That's one more reason not to accept a quick settlement offer before understanding the full scope of your injuries.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Hawthorne Boulevard or another busy Rancho Palos Verdes corridor?
items.answer: High-traffic roads like Hawthorne Boulevard, Western Avenue, and Palos Verdes Drive S see a steady share of the city's reported injury collisions. Documenting the scene, getting a police report number, and seeking medical care quickly all help build a stronger record regardless of where the crash happened.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront fee to speak with someone about your Rancho Palos Verdes car accident.
